mobile.stickers.none_hint: Add pictures to your own pack, or to this room’s, and send them as stickers.
mobile.stickers.gif_refused: GIPHY refused your API key. Check it, or enter another.
mobile.stickers.giphy_needed: Searching GIFs needs your own GIPHY API key
mobile.stickers.giphy_explain: Better Matrix is open source and has no GIPHY account of its own. Create a free API key on GIPHY’s developer site, then enter it here. It stays on this device; GIPHY sees your searches and which GIFs you send.
mobile.stickers.giphy_hint: The GIFs in the sticker picker come from GIPHY, searched with your own API key, which stays on this device.
mobile.stickers.yours_hint: Yours to send in every room.
mobile.stickers.room_packs_hint: Everyone in this room can send these.
mobile.stickers.elsewhere_hint: Packs from other rooms that you use in all your rooms.
mobile.stickers.everywhere_hint: Send this pack’s stickers and emoji in every room, not only here.
mobile.stickers.read_only: Only people allowed to change this room’s settings can change its packs.
mobile.stickers.delete_pack_body: Its stickers and emoji are gone for everyone in the room.
mobile.stickers.shortcode_hint: Typed as :code: to use it as an emoji. No spaces or colons.
mobile.stickers.shortcode_invalid: Use only letters A–Z, digits, - and _ (at most 100).
mobile.stickers.description_hint: What it shows, for screen readers and other apps.
mobile.stickers.use_hint: Send it on its own as a sticker, use it in text as an emoji, or both.
mobile.stickers.remove_body: It leaves the pack for everyone who uses it.
mobile.stickers.giphy_saved: A GIPHY key is saved in this device's secure storage.
mobile.stickers.giphy_save_failed: The GIPHY key couldn't be saved on this device: {{error}}
mobile.stickers.giphy_remove_failed: The GIPHY key couldn't be removed from this device: {{error}}
mobile.stickers.copy_encrypted_body: It was sent encrypted. To make it a sticker, a copy is uploaded to your homeserver without encryption: your server can see it, and so can anyone who gets its link.
